caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile with a predominantly blue and white color scheme. The central part of the textile features a symmetrical floral medallion with large blooming flowers and leafy motifs arranged in a circular pattern. Surrounding the central medallion, there are repeated large white floral designs, interspersed with small star shapes on a blue background. The bottom section of the textile displays architectural elements such as columns and domed buildings, as well as American eagle motifs. The lower right quadrant contains a block of text in white on a blue background that reads: “AGRICULTURES MANUFACTURES ARE THE FOUNDATION OF OUR INDEPENDENCE JULY 4. 1823.” Additional decorative features include more geometric and star motifs. The edges of the textile are frayed. The drawing is labeled “Westchester County” in the bottom left corner and “Wm Shearwood” in the bottom right corner.
title: Woven Wool Coverlet
